_provenance.authored_from: Voyage embeddings API published response schema. The documentation states that data rows carry an explicit index; it does not promise arrival order, which is why the client sorts on index rather than trusting position.
_provenance.notes: The rows below are deliberately reversed. This fixture exists to prove the client restores request order, because an out-of-order batch attaches every candidate's vector to the next candidate's row and no test of the happy path would show it.
